top.line: Sovereignty is being able to move, not where you are hosted: the website cell as a sovereign competitor.

in-short.line: A direct competitor; hosting is not sovereignty; move the data and schema; the cell passes; others build on it.

competitor.line: The website cell competes with Wix, Squarespace, WordPress hosts and AI builders.

hosting.line: A Dublin-hosted platform whose terms keep your site is not sovereign.

requires.line: Open source, owned schemas, not one SLA from losing access, and nationality that acquisitions cannot move.

tests.line: Movable, schema owned, terms yours, unchanged if we are bought.

europe.line: No cookies by default, open standards, any region, ten languages.
europe.para: A sovereign site, not a label.

business.line: Partners, agencies and newsrooms build on it; RiskMandate's policies keep the agents in line.
business.para: A large business on its own.

limits.line: Possibilities not guarantees; standard terms; a soft requirement.

sources.line: open-source.sgit.ai, Fliplet, Squarespace reporting and earlier articles.
